newsitem.title: UK: LME copper holds gains during evening session.
newsitem.headline: LME copper holds gains during evening session.

text.p: London Metal Exchange copper price held most of Tuesday's gains after an exuberant day's trading which was driven by nearby tightness, traders said.
By 1800 GMT, three months copper was indicated at $2,347 against a kerb close of $2,348, which was just a dollar off the day's high gained after stops were hit as the price surged over $2,300.
The cash-three's backwardation surged to over $100 from around $60 on Monday.
Aluminium was indicated at $1,600, about $7 above the kerb close after earlier trading was encouraged by a 4,700-tonne fall in LME warehouse stocks.
The other metals held near their late kerb closing levels.
